entities.name: Conditional reconfiguration removal
entities.description: Procedure where the UE removes conditional reconfiguration entries based on the condReconfigToRemoveList.

entities.name: condReconfigToRemoveList
entities.description: List containing condReconfigId values that should be removed from the UE's conditional reconfiguration.

entities.name: condReconfigId
entities.description: Identifier for conditional reconfiguration entries in the UE's storage.

entities.name: VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: UE variable storing the current conditional reconfiguration entries.

entities.name: condReconfigId in both condReconfigToRemoveList and VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: Condition where a condReconfigId value exists in both the removal list and the current UE conditional reconfiguration.

entities.name: Remove entry from VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: Action where the UE removes the conditional reconfiguration entry with matching condReconfigId from VarConditionalReconfig.

relations.description: The conditional reconfiguration removal procedure uses the condReconfigToRemoveList information element.
The procedure is guarded by the condition that condReconfigId must be in both the removal list and current configuration.
When the condition is met, the UE establishes the removal of the entry from VarConditionalReconfig.
The removal action is defined to operate on the VarConditionalReconfig variable.
